headline: Dacia had its weakest October since the 2021 microchip crisis: only 20,373 cars at Mioveni, a third below last year's level
summary: Dacia's Mioveni plant produced 20,373 cars in October, 34.8% fewer than a year earlier. It was the weakest October since 2021 and the largest monthly decline this year, according to ACAROM data.
why: Dacia is the Romanian brand of Renault, and Mioveni is one of Romania's largest car plants, making its output significant for Romanian industry and exports.

original_headline: Dacia a avut cel mai slab octombrie de la criza microcipurilor din 2021: doar 20.373 de maşini la Mioveni, cu o treime sub nivelul de anul trecut
